slices.name: Truthful Frontend Evidence
slices.objective: Remove false-green coverage credit and ensure default Vitest credits only current product surfaces.
slices.exit: All four coverage and three test-selection counterexamples deterministically fail, valid inputs pass, and the credited default test set excludes retired Stage/Step/dev-harness evidence.

task_packet_blueprint.objective: Make coverage threshold enforcement and default frontend test credit truthful.
non_goals: Do not lower coverage thresholds to obtain green.
Do not delete historical evidence; remove it only from default current-product credit.
Do not touch Rust, Tauri, external providers, Keychain or product data.
task_packet_blueprint.invariant: Missing, malformed, zero-collection, below-threshold, forbidden-credit and test-ID-drift evidence fails; valid evidence passes; default credited tests represent current product surfaces only.
task_packet_blueprint.minimal_fix_contract: Use one deterministic parser/checker authority and an explicit current-test include/exclude contract; do not add a second coverage truth.
task_packet_blueprint.old_path_deletion_contract: Remove the inline false-green parser when the single checker replaces it; retired tests remain historical but lose default credit.
acceptance_criteria: All four named coverage counterexamples exit nonzero for the stated reason.
All three named selection counterexamples exit nonzero for the stated reason.
A valid coverage artifact passes the same checker.
Default credited test IDs/count exclude retired Stage1, Step6, dev-harness and tauriDev-dependent evidence while retaining current tauri wrapper tests.
Production build and absence guard remain green.
stop_conditions: Frozen source map or canonical owner is false.
A write is required outside allowed_touched_paths.
An expected-absent object would be recreated.
A required RED cannot be made to fail for the stated reason.
A closure-candidate proof has not failed before conditional implementation.
The same root cause has failed three implementation attempts.
The hard-stop size budget is exceeded; split the slice or stop for a successor Program.
External action or durable write needs authority not present in the packet.
task_packet_blueprint.ledger_update_contract: Integrator records R3-N010/R3-N020 evidence and W0 outcome at the exact reviewed head; implementation Agent does not grant closure.
task_packet_blueprint.handoff_contract: Return changed paths, raw RED/positive outputs, exact head SHA, residual UNKNOWN and independent challenge result.

non_goals: Do not turn an evidence-determinism slice into an unreviewed lease product fix.
Do not change external-provider, Keychain or durable product-data behavior.
Do not claim a stable run unless the complete fixed repetition contract is recorded.
slices.exit: Focused 20 repetitions and two serial full-workspace repetitions have no unexplained variation; otherwise the blocker remains.

non_goals: Do not claim BR4-D064 remediation or closure.
Do not migrate, rotate or delete the retained Keychain secret.
Do not expand into provider or product-data trials.

Do not modify Rust, Tauri, React or frontend product behavior.

freeze_contract.packet_sha256_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON after replacing packet_sha256 with null.
freeze_contract.packet_payload_sha256_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON after replacing packet_sha256, packet_payload_sha256 and packet_freeze_review with null.
freeze_contract.packet_freeze_review_rule: PASS review by a reviewer other than the Integrator, bound to packet_payload_sha256 with a nonempty durable artifact or record.
freeze_contract.execution_baseline_rule: The packet execution_baseline_sha and expected_parent_main_sha must equal the CLI baseline and the current local main tip.
freeze_contract.activation_rule: program_activation_sha must resolve, be an ancestor of the execution baseline, and identify an activated Program state.
freeze_contract.branch_rule: The actual short branch must equal packet.branch and use codex/.
freeze_contract.scope_rule: All committed, staged, unstaged and untracked task changes since execution_baseline_sha must satisfy allowed paths and must not match forbidden or expected-absent paths.
freeze_contract.blueprint_credit: BLUEPRINT_NOT_FROZEN packets cannot authorize implementation or evidence credit.
freeze_contract.later_wave_packet_rule: A slice without an approved inline blueprint may use a reviewed frozen packet only after its Wave is READY/IN_PROGRESS, every finding is assigned to that Wave, one root cluster is named, the source/owner map resolves at the execution baseline, all external-action defaults remain false, and the packet freeze review passes.

review_policy.low_risk: No GitHub human approval is required by this Program, but every integrated task still requires an independent Agent challenge bound to the exact head SHA.
review_policy.high_risk: Canonical authority, durable write, permission, external effect, schema, migration and Keychain changes require an independent head-SHA challenge; this Program has no waiver-to-merge lane.

mistakes.title: 分支和 worktree 被当成并行产品现实，而不是短期运输工具
mistakes.impact: 集成真相、责任归属和恢复路径依赖个人记忆；同一逻辑修复会以不同 SHA 重复出现。

mistakes.title: 把过大、过快、混合关注点的变更作为可审查集成单元
mistakes.impact: 门禁通过无法说明哪个不变量由哪个变更保护，审查、回滚和责任定位都失去边界。

mistakes.title: 路演等紧急目标直接覆盖主开发序列，混合演示、修复、证据和缺陷发现
mistakes.impact: 功能交付、缺陷修复、验收证据和 backlog 扩张进入同一关键路径，原序列失去可恢复入口。

mistakes.title: 完成、就绪和最终等语言没有绑定证据维度
mistakes.impact: 后续开发者必须重新判断 complete 指本地单测、浏览器壳、原生应用、外部 Provider 还是全局产品验收。

mistakes.title: 把绿灯、测试数量和检查名称当成证据，而没有反向测试门禁本身
mistakes.impact: 机械绿不能证明被命名的质量保证；团队可能在错误的停止点结束修复，或持续维护已退役的证据系统。

mistakes.title: 新增替代路径时没有同时删除旧写入者、旧路由和影子契约
mistakes.impact: 同一用户意图可能因入口不同而获得不同的策略、持久化、确认、审计和恢复语义。

mistakes.title: 把未知、损坏和不可用折成空、零、默认、健康或完成
mistakes.impact: 产品会把缺失或损坏的真相呈现为正常状态，并允许后续动作建立在伪造的健康值上。

mistakes.title: 把一个用户操作拆成多存储、多步骤副作用，却没有操作级原子所有者和故障矩阵
mistakes.impact: 重试、取消、崩溃和部分提交会产生无法可靠解释的中间态；同一外层错误也可能隐藏不同失败层。

mistakes.title: 验证停在表面边界，没有把验证后的能力一直带到真实副作用和全局资源边界
mistakes.impact: 局部 data dir 或表层 schema 校验不能约束 Keychain、锁、文件描述符、叶子路径和最终外部写入。

mistakes.title: 文档、阶段和大型权威模块持续增长，但没有可执行的退休与增长预算
mistakes.impact: 搜索结果容易把历史执行语言当成当前权威；新行为继续进入高耦合 owner，形式上的拆分没有降低变更半径。

mistakes.title: 缺少可验证的独立挑战记录，但也不能伪造或强行要求不存在的第二审批者
mistakes.impact: 机械门禁、自审和独立挑战容易被混为一谈，高风险修改缺少绑定到 head SHA 的反证过程。

prevention_controls.rule: 唯一可写 checkout 固定为 /Users/tw/Desktop/open-life；不新建 sibling repo 或长期 worktree。
远端和本地长期 branch 只保留 main；短分支合入后立即删除。
合入前运行 patch-id/cherry 检查，拒绝无 backport 说明的重复逻辑提交。
普通 PR 设 files/churn/concern 预算；超过预算必须拆分或记录例外。
每个集成任务都必须有绑定 head SHA 的独立 Agent challenge；高风险修改不得使用 waiver 绕过。
契约、测试、实现、证据使用可单独审查的提交；禁止 WIP 聚合提交同时跨产品/文档/二进制/基础设施。
紧急插队前冻结 SHA、未完成项和恢复条件；插队结束必须回到同一 main 重新裁决。
V4、roadshow、Stage 和 Step 仅作为历史证据，不能恢复为当前执行权威。
演示分支不得扩张全局 backlog 或宣告全局 closure；只记录演示场景内证据。
状态必须绑定 SHA、profile、scenario 和 evidence dimension；禁止裸 complete/final/ready。
浏览器壳、原生 Tauri、外部 Provider、durable write 与 finding closure 分开计分。
先测试 CI 脚本自己的失败路径；缺文件、非数字、零收集、跳过必需断言必须失败。
修复或移除当前 required Frontend Coverage 假绿检查，修复前不得把它计作质量信用。
默认测试入口只包含当前产品表面；退役 Stage/Step 测试不可制造默认信号。
新增替代路径的验收必须同时包含 canonical owner、release reachability 和 expected-absent 删除证明。
持久化解码和产品 read model 对未知/损坏/不可用 fail closed，不得默认成有效域值。
每个多存储用户操作先定义事务/journal/outbox owner 和 fail-before/fail-after/retry/cancel/restart 矩阵。
隔离测试清单必须覆盖文件系统、Keychain、锁、FD、socket 和外部服务；构造函数副作用显式化。
一个 active authority index；历史文档保留历史状态但携带 current_disposition；模块增长采用 owner/fan-out ratchet。
不强制 GitHub 人工批准，但任何低风险或高风险任务在集成前都必须通过独立 Agent challenge；formal review 数量必须如实记录。

positive_controls_to_preserve: 当前只有一个 worktree、一个本地 main 和一个远端 main。
删除 refs 前已用 verified bundle 和 archive tags 保证恢复性。
V4 的 13 个独有提交已逐个分类，still-needed-port 为 0，closure 仍为 UNKNOWN。
plans/README.md 已把 V4、roadshow、Stage 和 Step6 降为历史证据。
当前权威使用 red-until-trial-green 与 fail-closed 完成边界。
PR #65 把 compile/unit 与 browser-shell 分开命名，并诚实记录 owner-authorized direct merge。

rewrite_reconsideration.spike_budget: At most two non-shipping spikes, each capped at five engineering days and ten touched source files, with owner, paths, invariant, failure criterion and discard plan frozen before work.
rewrite_reconsideration.cost_unit: Engineering days including implementation, 101-card remapping, real-data migration, rollback, parity tests, independent challenge and temporary dual-maintenance cost.
rewrite_reconsideration.material_threshold: Rewrite median estimate must be at least 30 percent lower than in-place convergence, and its upper uncertainty bound must not exceed the in-place median.
rewrite_reconsideration.evidence_boundary: Spike prototypes grant architecture evidence only and cannot enter the shipped product or create a second product route.

explicit_unknowns: Seven historical OPEN_UNKNOWN cards remain unresolved; six cards lack current source refs.
V4 finding closure remains UNKNOWN despite zero still-needed-port commits.
The semantic equivalence of all 63 May archive patch-unique commits is not exhausted.
The final product impact and original occurrence attribution of R4-FLAKY-001 remain UNKNOWN.
The final user impact and full multi-profile/process behavior of BR4-D064 remain UNKNOWN.
External provider, non-loopback network, live MCP/A2A, real durable write and real product-data behavior lack current credit.
Whether every large current owner can be converged in place remains to be proven by bounded slices.

initial_publication_boundary.initial_next_transition: At initial publication only: bind the independent challenge to the frozen draft commit, obtain explicit user approval of that exact commit, then create the activation-only child before any implementation dispatch.
initial_publication_boundary.live_transition_authority: After activation, read live Program, Wave, gate and ledger state from this JSON rather than treating this initial-publication note as current status.

non_negotiable_invariants: Phase7 remains red-until-trial-green until its exact required scenarios pass.
Expected-absent product routes, writers and modules are not recreated.
No silent durable write, external provider action, Keychain deletion or product-data deletion.
One canonical owner per product truth or effect boundary.
Unknown, corrupt, unavailable, blocked and proposal-only states fail closed.
Browser-shell, native Tauri, external-live, durable-write and finding-closure evidence do not transfer credit.
One writable OpenLife checkout and main as the only long-term branch.

ordered_steps: Draft Program, ledger, active authority, validator and mutation self-test agree.
Independent challenge is bound to the exact frozen draft commit.
The user explicitly approves that exact reviewed draft.
An activation change records the approved draft commit and sets execution_authorized=true.
Activation validation passes before W0-S2 packet preparation and dispatch.
program_activation.activation_commit_derivation: For the approved draft, the first commit on the ancestry path to the current HEAD must be its single-parent direct child, change only Program JSON and ledger JSON, and pass the activation-only overlay contract. Ongoing and task-packet validation replays that commit instead of trusting current status fields.

triggers: Wave order, dependency, gate, evidence vocabulary or authority changes.
A new external-action or durable-write authority is requested.
